added_lines: remembering our dead november masses & evening prayer monday 2nd november is the feast of all souls. mass for feast of all souls will be celebrated in glenbeigh monday evening at 7:30pm and in glencar at 6pm. mass for the holy souls and those remem-bered on the all souls lists, will be celebrated in glenbeigh on monday 2nd november and on the monday evenings of the 9th./16th./23rd .of november. all these masses will be celebrated at 7:30pm. masses for the holy souls and those remembered on the all souls lists in glencar will be celebrated at 6 p.m. on mon-day 2nd november and on the saturday evenings of the 7th /14th./21st. november . at the mass on monday 23rd. november parishioners who died since last november whose requiems took place in the parish will be especially remembered. a candle in their memory will be brought to the sanctuary and placed on a stand before the altar at the beginning of the mass. please collect your november envelope at the back of the church and return it in time for these celebrations . i ask all clubs and organisations not to have their events clash with these november masses for our dead; and the saturday even-ing mass in glencar and sunday morning mass in glenbeigh at any time . thank you . st james church - st. stephens glencar 25 october 2026 - 30th. sunday in ordinary time fr. kieran o’ sullivan - the presbytery, glenbeigh
